column1: # Asks that pick a project back up, and the project each names (empty: not
# a resume). Both `friday ask` (friday_continue_restore, which restores the
# workspace) and the daemon (timeline::resumed, which adds the history) are
# tested against this table, so they can't drift apart.
continue working on my garden planner
get back to working on FRIDAY
prepare my desk for the site
get back to me on the budget
